# ScienceInsights

> > ScienceInsights provides evidence-based explanations of scientific concepts spanning medical diagnostics, microbiology, environmental science, and biology.

The site covers laboratory techniques like immunoassay testing, GC-MS, and LC-MS/MS for medical diagnostics, alongside topics in microbiology (biofilm formation, antibiotic resistance), climate science (AMOC collapse), molecular biology (DNA structure, parthenogenesis), and natural history. Content is designed to make complex scientific principles accessible through clear, detailed explanations.

## Key Topics

- Immunoassay testing and antibody-antigen interactions
- Medical diagnostics (HIV, hepatitis, COVID-19)
- Laboratory techniques (GC-MS, LC-MS/MS)
- Drug testing and hair follicle analysis
- Biofilm formation and quorum sensing
- Antibiotic resistance in healthcare
- DNA structure and molecular biology
- Environmental persistence and plastic degradation
- Nuclear imaging (PET, SPECT)
- Asexual reproduction and parthenogenesis
- Climate systems (AMOC)
- Microbial pathogens (C. diff, Citrobacter, Providencia)
- Wildlife biology and behavior
- Pest control ecology

## Medical Diagnostics & Laboratory Testing

- [What Is Immunoassay Testing and How Does It Work?](https://scienceinsights.org/what-is-immunoassay-testing-and-how-does-it-work): Explains immunoassay testing for detecting HIV, hepatitis, COVID-19
- [How to Read Hair Follicle Test Results and Levels](https://scienceinsights.org/how-to-read-hair-follicle-test-results-and-levels): Guide to interpreting hair follicle drug test results using GC-MS/LC-MS
- [SPECT Scan vs. PET Scan: Key Differences Explained](https://scienceinsights.org/spect-scan-vs-pet-scan-key-differences-explained): Compares SPECT and PET nuclear imaging using Technetium-99m radiotracers

## Microbiology & Infectious Disease

- [What Is Biofilm Formation and How Does It Happen?](https://scienceinsights.org/what-is-biofilm-formation-and-how-does-it-happen): Explores microbial biofilm formation via quorum sensing and EPS matrix
- [What Kills C. diff Spores? Effective Disinfection Methods](https://scienceinsights.org/what-kills-c-diff-spores-effective-disinfection-methods): EPA-approved sporicidal methods for Clostridioides difficile decontamination
- [When the Citrobacter freundii Complex Becomes a Threat](https://scienceinsights.org/when-the-citrobacter-freundii-complex-becomes-a-threat): Covers Citrobacter freundii as opportunistic pathogen in healthcare settings
- [What Are Providencia Bacteria and Are They Dangerous?](https://scienceinsights.org/what-are-providencia-bacteria-and-are-they-dangerous): Covers Providencia stuartii and antibiotic-resistant healthcare infections

## Molecular Biology & Genetics

- [What Is Simple DNA and How Does It Work?](https://scienceinsights.org/what-is-simple-dna-and-how-does-it-work): Introduces DNA structure fundamentals including nucleotide bases and replication
- [What Is Parthenogenesis? The Science of Virgin Birth](https://scienceinsights.org/what-is-parthenogenesis-the-science-of-virgin-birth): Explains asexual reproduction in Komodo dragons, aphids, bees, wasps
- [How Spontaneous Generation Was Disproved](https://scienceinsights.org/how-spontaneous-generation-was-disproved): History of Redi, Spallanzani experiments disproving spontaneous generation

## Environmental Science & Climate

- [What Would Happen If the AMOC Collapsed?](https://scienceinsights.org/what-would-happen-if-the-amoc-collapsed): Examines climate impacts of Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation collapse
- [How Long Does It Take for Plastic to Degrade?](https://scienceinsights.org/how-long-does-it-take-for-plastic-to-degrade): Details plastic degradation timelines and environmental persistence of PET

## Wildlife Biology & Natural History

- [What Are the Different Types of Black Bees?](https://scienceinsights.org/what-are-the-different-types-of-black-bees): Identifies black bee species: Xylocopa carpenter bees, Andrena mining bees
- [The European Fallow Deer: Appearance, Habitat, and Life](https://scienceinsights.org/the-european-fallow-deer-appearance-habitat-and-life): Profiles Dama dama biology, habitat from Turkey to Italian Peninsula
- [What Do Skunks Eat? A Look at Their Omnivorous Diet](https://scienceinsights.org/what-do-skunks-eat-a-look-at-their-omnivorous-diet): Details North American skunk omnivorous diet and pest control role
- [When Do Mosquitoes Go Away for the Season?](https://scienceinsights.org/when-do-mosquitoes-go-away-for-the-season): Explains mosquito seasonal cycles including Culex and Aedes species
- [Why Do Spiders Take Down Their Webs?](https://scienceinsights.org/why-do-spiders-take-down-their-webs): Explains spider web recycling behavior and silk protein conservation

## Optional

- [How Much Protein Is in Rice?](https://scienceinsights.org/how-much-protein-is-in-rice): Analyzes protein content and amino acid profile across rice varieties
- [What Wild Animal Has Black Poop?](https://scienceinsights.org/what-wild-animal-has-black-poop): Wildlife tracking guide identifying black bear, raccoon, coyote scat
- [What Does It Mean When a Hummingbird Comes Right Up to You?](https://scienceinsights.org/what-does-it-mean-when-a-hummingbird-comes-right-up-to-you): Explores hummingbird territorial behavior and symbolic interpretations
